ability.name: Kunai Strike
ability.en: Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing 155/235/370 physical damage. If the target is Burning, deal an additional 35/52/80 damage. If the ability kills, cast it again.
ability.ar: ترمي وابلًا من الشوريكن على الهدف، مسببةً 155/235/370 ضررًا جسديًا. إذا كان الهدف محترقًا، تسبب 35/52/80 ضررًا إضافيًا. وإذا قتلت القدرة الهدف، تُلقى مرة أخرى.

ability.name: Defensive Sweep
ability.en: Slice the target for 170/255/435 physical damage and gain a 60 Shield for 2 seconds.
ability.ar: تضرب الهدف مسببةً 170/255/435 ضررًا جسديًا، وتحصل على درع بقوة 60 لمدة ثانيتين.

ability.name: Razor Leaves
ability.en: Summons five razor leaves at the target, dealing 310/465/700% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage total and applying Wound and Burn for 4 seconds. Each cast, Cinderling gains 22% Attack Damage.

ability.name: Karmic Bond
ability.en: Tethers the target for 280/420/630 AP magic damage over 1.5 seconds, then bursts for 125/185/300 AP magic damage to all enemies in a 1-hex radius and Slows them 30% for 2 seconds.

ability.name: Dance of Life
ability.en: Restore 314/364/509 Health over 2 seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals 140/175/220 magic damage.
ability.ar: يستعيد 314/364/509 من الصحة على مدار ثانيتين. ويتحول هجومه التالي إلى ضربة قوية تسبب 140/175/220 ضررًا سحريًا.

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.en: Passive: Start combat with 60/70/80 bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over 12 seconds. Active: Bash the current target, dealing 60/108/162 magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
ability.ar: سلبي: تبدأ القتال مع 60/70/80 درعًا ومقاومة سحرية إضافية تتناقص على مدار 12 ثانية. نشط: تضرب الهدف الحالي مسببةً 60/108/162 ضررًا سحريًا وتصيبه بالذهول لمدة 1.5 ثانية.

ability.name: Bellows Breath
ability.en: Gains a 400/460/550 AP Shield for 4 seconds and deals 200/300/450 AP magic damage in a cone. Blocked damage is stored and eventually converts into an Artifact Anvil.

ability.name: Azure Laser
ability.en: Channels a laser on the target, dealing 160/240/360 AP magic damage each second and reducing their Magic Resist by 3. Gains bonus Mana Regen the longer he channels.

ability.name: Entrancing Dance
ability.en: Gains a 270/320/415 AP Shield for 4 seconds, then grants the ally who dealt the most damage this combat bonus Ability Power and decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Uproot
ability.en: Passive: heals 10/14/20 Health per second, tripled for 3 seconds after casting. Active: lunges out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for 1 second and dealing 70/105/160 AP magic damage.

ability.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.en: Winds up, then fires an arrow through the most enemies in line, dealing 415/625/1000% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage, reduced 40% for each enemy it passes through.

ability.name: Primordial Burst
ability.en: Launch a giant blast at the target that deals 175/265/395 magic damage, increased to 265/400/595 if they are below 30% maximum Health. If they die, permanently gain 1.5% Ability Power.
ability.ar: يطلق انفجارًا قويًا على الهدف يسبب 175/265/395 ضررًا سحريًا، ويرتفع إلى 265/400/595 إذا كانت صحة الهدف أقل من 30% من صحته القصوى. إذا مات الهدف، يحصل فيجار بشكل دائم على 1.5% من قوة القدرة.

ability.name: Deadly Plumage
ability.en: Gains 50% Attack Speed for the next 5 attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers dealing 68/102/155% AD physical damage and reducing Armor.

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.en: Passive: on death, spawns a Spirit Walker that taunts enemies. Active: restores Health and strikes the target, dealing 150/225/340 AP physical damage.

ability.name: Triumphant Roar
ability.en: Roars, cleansing disables and healing the two lowest-Health allies for 230/300/400 AP, then slams the target for 180/270/420 AP magic damage and Stuns them for 1.5 seconds.

ability.name: Headshot
ability.en: Passive: every third attack is replaced with a Headshot dealing 190/285/470% AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage.

ability.name: Spider Queen
ability.en: Transform into a spider and gain 375 maximum Health. Attacks in Spider Form deal 35/50/80 bonus magic damage and heal for 55/90/170. Subsequent casts grant 175% decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.
ability.ar: تتحول إلى عنكبوت وتكتسب 375 صحة قصوى. تسبب هجماتها في هيئة العنكبوت 35/50/80 ضررًا سحريًا إضافيًا وتستعيد 55/90/170 صحة. تمنح الإلقاءات التالية 175% سرعة هجوم تتناقص تدريجيًا لمدة 4 ثوانٍ.

ability.name: Belchy Bubble
ability.en: Adaptor (AP): throws a bubble that explodes for 225/340/535 AP magic damage, then deals 175/265/410 AP magic damage over time in a small radius. Adaptor (AD): heavily Slows the target instead.

ability.name: Solar Judgement
ability.en: Passive: Kayle ascends based on her star level, gaining stacking bonuses. Attacks deal bonus magic damage; later ascensions add Shred, waves that damage other units, and infinite range.
ability.ar: سلبي: ترتقي كايل بحسب مستوى النجوم، وتكتسب مكافآت متراكمة. تسبب الهجمات ضررًا سحريًا إضافيًا؛ وتضيف الارتقاءات اللاحقة تقليلًا للمقاومة، وموجات تصيب وحدات أخرى، ومدى هجوم غير محدود.

ability.name: Mirror Image
ability.en: Passive: after combat, has a chance to duplicate an ally on the board. Active: launches a mirror image dealing 260/390/615 AP magic damage to the target and 100/150/230 AP to nearby enemies.

ability.name: Rending Claws
ability.en: Leap to the lowest-Health enemy within range and deal physical damage. The next attacks deal bonus physical damage.
ability.ar: يقفز إلى العدو ذي أقل صحة ضمن المدى ويسبب له ضررًا جسديًا. وتسبب الهجمات التالية ضررًا جسديًا إضافيًا.

ability.name: Can You Dig It?
ability.en: Passive: attacks are replaced by a dance dealing physical damage to all adjacent enemies. Active: burrows underground, gaining Durability and healing 325/400/675 AP over the duration.

ability.name: Sun's Wrath
ability.en: Gains a Shield for 4 seconds, then cleaves for 90/135/205 AP magic damage in a cone and strikes for 120/180/270 AP magic damage in a line.

ability.name: Ki Barrier
ability.en: Grants a Shield to himself and a nearby damaged ally for 4 seconds. Both then gain Attack Speed and deal 35/55/80 AP bonus magic damage on their next 3 attacks.

ability.name: Fungus Among Us
ability.en: Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal 60/90/135 magic damage to the 3 nearest enemies, then hurl a giant mushroom at the target for 135/200/310 magic damage. Each cast has a chance to forage an extra mushroom.
ability.ar: يرمي مجموعتين من الفطر تسببان 60/90/135 ضررًا سحريًا لأقرب 3 أعداء، ثم يرمي فطرًا ضخمًا على الهدف يسبب 135/200/310 ضررًا سحريًا. لكل إلقاء فرصة للعثور على فطر إضافي.

ability.name: Jaws of The Beast
ability.en: Bites the target, dealing 230/345/535% AD physical damage and healing for 25% of the damage dealt. Gains 20% Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit
ability.en: Dashes, then launches an orb at the target dealing 160/240/370% AD physical damage, which splits and hits 2 nearby enemies for 35% of that damage.

ability.name: Arise!
ability.en: Gains 150% Attack Speed and summons 2 soldiers for the next 6 attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands, each dealing 46/69/110 AP magic damage per soldier.

ability.name: Noxious Blast
ability.en: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing 425/640/1020 magic damage over 15 seconds. Poisons stack.
ability.ar: يسمم الهدف وأقرب عدو غير مسموم، مسببًا 425/640/1020 ضررًا سحريًا على مدار 15 ثانية. ويمكن أن تتراكم تأثيرات السم.

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.en: Gains a Shield for 2 seconds and sends 6 moonlight orbs among nearby enemies, each dealing 75/115/180 AP magic damage.

ability.name: Harvest
ability.en: Reduces the Magic Resist of the 3 nearest enemies, then drains life from them over 2 seconds, healing 410/485/850 AP and dealing 70/105/170 AP magic damage to each.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.en: Gains bonus resistances and heals 375/475/685 AP Health over 3 seconds, then launches spectral riders at the 3 nearest enemies dealing 80/120/195 AP magic damage and Stunning them.

ability.name: Taste Their Fear
ability.en: Leaps to the farthest enemy within range and deals 285/400/580 AP magic damage. If that enemy has no adjacent allies, deals 310/445/660 AP damage instead and gains mana.

ability.name: Raining Artillery
ability.en: Adaptor (AD): fires acid at the target and the nearest enemy, dealing 145/220/375% AD + 20/30/50 AP physical damage, increased 40% against enemies below 50% Health. Adaptor (AP): the damage becomes a damage-over-time effect.

ability.name: Rock and Roll
ability.en: Passive: on death, splits into two Kruglettes that taunt enemies. Active: gains bonus max Health, then rolls into the target dealing 135/200/335% AD physical damage plus a percentage of their max Health.

ability.name: Wuju Style
ability.en: Passive: Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed. Adaptor: Double Strikes grant stacking Attack Speed or deal bonus damage and heal, depending on the chosen form.
ability.ar: سلبي: كل هجوم ثالث يصبح ضربة مزدوجة. عند الإطاحة بعدو، يحصل على دفعة من سرعة الحركة. مع صفة المتكيف، تمنح الضربات المزدوجة سرعة هجوم متراكمة أو تسبب ضررًا إضافيًا وتستعيد الصحة، حسب الشكل المختار.

ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl
ability.en: Taunt enemies. For 4 seconds, gain a 350/450/550 Shield and 60 Armor and Magic Resist. When the Shield breaks, deal 50/75/120 physical damage to enemies within 2 hexes.
ability.ar: يسخر من الأعداء. لمدة 4 ثوانٍ، يحصل على درع بقوة 350/450/550 و60 درعًا ومقاومة سحرية. عند تحطم الدرع، يسبب 50/75/120 ضررًا جسديًا للأعداء ضمن خليتين.

ability.name: Flock Friends
ability.en: Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks nearby for 5 seconds. Whenever Mama Beak attacks, Tiny Beaks attack the same enemy, dealing 22/33/48 physical damage.
ability.ar: تستدعي 4 فراخ صغيرة لا يمكن استهدافها بالقرب منها لمدة 5 ثوانٍ. كلما هاجمت ماما بيك، تهاجم الفراخ العدو نفسه، مسببةً 22/33/48 ضررًا جسديًا.

ability.name: Savagery
ability.en: Jumps to the lowest-Health-percent enemy within range and stabs them, dealing 255/385/615% AD physical damage, then heals based on their missing Health.

ability.name: Explosive Charge
ability.en: Attaches an explosive charge to the target for 4 seconds, gaining infinite range and Attack Speed. When it expires, it explodes for 160/240/385% AD physical damage split among nearby enemies.

ability.name: Furious Fists
ability.en: Passive: heals a percentage of max Health on attack. Active: heals 200/265/360 AP Health, then gains massive Attack Speed, Durability, and becomes Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Spirit Bomb
ability.en: Launches a spirit bomb at the spot with the most surrounding enemies within range, dealing 455/685/3500 AP magic damage in a 3-hex radius, reduced the further from the center.

ability.name: Tantrum
ability.en: Passive: heals and deals magic damage to nearby enemies every second. Active: deals 100/150/2000 AP magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes and Stuns them for 1/1/6 seconds.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.en: Gains a large Shield for 4 seconds, then slams the ground toward the most enemies, knocking them up and dealing 100/150/3500 AP magic damage plus a Mana Reave effect.

ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
ability.en: Swipes the target 5 times over 2 seconds, each dealing 70/105/850% AD physical damage, then fires a final blast dealing 450/675/5000% AD + 40/60/225 AP physical damage split among nearby enemies.

ability.name: Crimson Fury
ability.en: Passive: When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing 155/235/1000 physical damage. Active: Gain 80/80/300% Attack Damage for 8 seconds. During this time, ignore 45/45/90% Armor. Red Buff: Attacks Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for 4% of max Health.
ability.ar: سلبي: عند موت الهدف، يقفز إلى الهدف التالي ويسبب 155/235/1000 ضررًا جسديًا. نشط: يكتسب 80/80/300% من ضرر الهجوم لمدة 8 ثوانٍ، ويتجاهل خلالها 45/45/90% من درع العدو. مع التعزيز الأحمر، تحرق هجماته الأعداء وتستعيد له 4% من صحته القصوى.

ability.name: Forest's Flurry
ability.en: Blinks away from the target, dealing 250/375/1200% AD physical damage and gaining Attack Speed. Every 4th cast fires a piercing blast dealing 385/580/2500% AD physical damage through the largest group of enemies.

ability.name: Lilting Lullaby
ability.en: Restore 300/400/800 Health and send 4 butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take 90/135/2000 magic damage and are put to Sleep for 1.5 seconds.
ability.ar: تستعيد 300/400/800 صحة، ثم ترسل 4 فراشات نحو الأعداء القريبين. يتلقى الأعداء المصابون 90/135/2000 ضررًا سحريًا ويدخلون في سبات لمدة 1.5 ثانية.

ability.name: Petrified Bark
ability.en: Gains a large Shield for 4 seconds and becomes petrified. When the Shield breaks, unleashes a shockwave dealing magic damage plus a portion of his Armor and Magic Resist to nearby enemies.

ability.name: Withering Curse
ability.en: Passive: gains Omnivamp. Active: fires a dark blast at 3 nearby enemies dealing magic damage and cursing them, then spawns a withering zone that deals damage over time; cursed enemies take extra damage per curse stack.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.en: Adaptor (AP): gains Attack Speed for 3 attacks that become javelins dealing 170/255/2000 AP magic damage; the third targets the furthest enemy with the fewest items for 330/500 AP damage. Adaptor (AD): transforms into a melee cougar dealing 210/315 AD physical damage per swipe.

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.en: Passive: gains mana the first time he drops below 40% Health each combat. Active: winds up, healing a large amount, then deals 150/225/5000% AD + a portion of max Health physical damage in a large cone.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.en: Gains a large Shield for 4 seconds, then slams the ground toward the most enemies, knocking them up and dealing 100/150/3500 AP magic damage plus a Mana Reave effect.

ability.name: Boomerang Blade
ability.en: Throws a crossblade dealing 190/285/1050% AD + 15/20/100 AP physical damage to the target, which bounces between nearby enemies up to 8 times, gaining extra bounces on kill.

ability.name: Starcall
ability.en: Calls down a star dealing 225/335/1000 AP magic damage. If a star has already hit that target before, calls 3 more stars dealing 100/150/1000 AP each.

ability.name: Rampant Growth
ability.en: Spawns 2/2/4 plants that attack the nearest enemy 10 times, each attack dealing 35/53/225 AP magic damage.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.en: Rains 9 moonshards split among the 3 nearest enemies, each dealing 55/83/500 AP magic damage. If the moon is full, instead crashes it down for a massive 2350/3600/7500 AP magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.en: Fires an arrow through the most enemies in a line, dealing 465/700/1000% AD physical damage (reduced per enemy hit), leaving a trail that deals damage over time and Slows enemies inside it.

ability.name: Whirling Death
ability.en: Passive: attacks apply a bleed that deals physical damage over 12 seconds. Active: throws two giant axes at the most-bleeding enemy, consuming their bleed for instant damage, then the axes return dealing more damage on the way back.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.en: Passive: attacks splash to adjacent enemies. Active: becomes invulnerable in the air, then on landing Stuns all enemies, gains Omnivamp, and Ignites them; immediately follows with Flame Breath — a line of fire dealing 285/435/7000% AD + 20/30/200 AP physical damage, executing enemies below 12% Health.

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.en: Passive: builds Rage over time and on attack. Active: transforms into Mega Gnar, leaping into the largest group of enemies, dealing physical damage, reducing their resistances, and Stunning them. Follows up with Grab n' Throw, hurling an enemy into others for massive physical damage.

ability.name: Triggerseed
ability.en: Grants a Shield and Damage Amp to several allies for 6 seconds, then deals magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After 6 casts, also grants those allies stacking Attack Speed.

ability.name: Firestorm
ability.en: Charges up (gaining Ability Power per Burning enemy), gains a Shield, rushes through enemies dealing magic damage, then unleashes a firestorm dealing a total of 475/715/5000 AP magic damage split among all enemies hit.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.en: Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain 3 Mana. Active: Fire a laser toward the largest group of enemies, dealing 375/565/6500 magic damage, reduced by 25/25/10% for each enemy hit. Her chosen Avatar aspect adds a unique effect.
ability.ar: سلبي: عند إلقاء القدرة، يحصل الحلفاء الذين يشاركون لوكس إحدى الصفات على 3 مانا. نشط: تطلق شعاعًا نحو أكبر تجمع للأعداء، مسببًا 375/565/6500 ضررًا سحريًا، ويقل الضرر بنسبة 25/25/10% لكل عدو يصيبه. يضيف جانب الأفاتار المختار تأثيرًا فريدًا.

champions.specialNote: Avatar: her chosen aspect can become one of the compatible origins and counts twice for that origin.

ability.name: Sow the Seeds
ability.en: Passive: after blocking a set amount of damage, a sapling jumps to a nearby enemy dealing magic damage; more saplings spawn on death. Active: deals magic damage to the target and restores Health equal to a portion of their missing Health.

ability.name: Emerald Radiance
ability.en: Passive: the first time Taric or his paired ally drops below 50% Health, both unleash energy granting nearby allies a 75/150 AP Shield. Active: heals himself for 275/450 AP and empowers his and his paired ally's next 2 attacks with bonus magic damage.
